title: Insurance Claim Services Arrangement Entry Schedule
content:
Insurance Claim Services files are opened under one of six claim billing arrangements. Each arrangement admits only the customer types and the instrument shown below; the instrument is what ties the company's billing to the carrier's claim.

## Entry gates

| Arrangement | Customer types admitted | Instrument on file | Further gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | homeowner, landlord, property manager, HOA, commercial owner | none (insured is paid by the carrier) | none |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | homeowner, landlord, property manager, HOA, commercial owner | signed direction to pay | none |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | homeowner, landlord, property manager, HOA | signed post-loss assignment of benefits | not a Florida policy issued on or after 2023-01-01 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | homeowner, landlord, HOA | carrier program referral number | none |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | homeowner, landlord, property manager, HOA, commercial owner | public adjuster letter of representation on file | none |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | commercial owner, HOA, property manager | signed direction to pay | estimate of at least 50000.00 USD |

## Instrument terms by arrangement

- **Public adjuster required** — whether a public adjuster must be on file, boolean.
- **Carrier referral required** — whether a carrier program referral number must be on file, boolean.
- **Assignment instrument** — whether the insured signs a post-loss assignment of benefits (rather than a direction to pay or nothing), boolean.
- **Minimum estimate amount** — smallest estimate a file of this tier may carry, USD.

| Arrangement | Public adjuster required | Carrier referral required | Assignment instrument | Minimum estimate amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | no | no | 0.00 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | no | no | no | 0.00 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | no | no | yes | 0.00 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | no | yes | no | 0.00 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | yes | no | no | 0.00 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | no | no | no | 50000.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- Exactly one arrangement carries each instrument requirement: a public adjuster only on Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing, a referral number only on Carrier Program Claim Billing, an assignment only on Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing.
- Only Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration sets a minimum estimate (50000.00 USD); every other arrangement shows 0.00.
- A commercial owner does not appear among the customer types of Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing or Carrier Program Claim Billing, and a homeowner or landlord does not appear among those of Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration.

*Example (hypothetical):* an association whose loss was referred by its carrier's program, with the referral number given, meets the Carrier Program Claim Billing gate; a commercial owner with the same referral does not, because commercial owners are not admitted to that arrangement.
